svg.title: We verify the continuation inheritance required in that induction. Its hypothesis is a tested rate inequality on every logarithmic path through the allowed chart: if the scalar continuation price has rate b, and each current group expression is affordable at its assigned radius with rate ci, the reading of their tagged product has rate at most b + P i ci. The continuation is also locally continuous on the specified palettes and constant in the normal directions already assigned to each group. These properties hold for the actual hierarchy with separated exterior fields by the signed expression estimates described below.
